mark: two open hands that never touch personal content
three_areas_two_wings: AI Origin Community: person-facing choice and joint-work review
Dazhongsi: account-free service and downstream reconciliation

agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_zh: 本人查看来源、版本与公开范围；不能核权则静默冻结
agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_en: The person reviews source, versions, and display scope; unresolved authority stays frozen

agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_zh: 共同署名与单方数据分开；权属争议只挂起相关分支
agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_en: Joint credit and individual data are separated; only disputed branches are held

agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_zh: 任一关系人不能单独续用；本人普通学习继续
agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_en: No related party may continue use alone; ordinary learning continues

agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_zh: 运营主体退出前交出目录、责任人和联络链
agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_en: The operator hands over inventory, owner, and contacts before exit

agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_zh: 无法定位派生物即停止扩展并登记缺口
agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_en: Unlocatable derivatives stop expansion and enter a gap register

agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_zh: 撤回同步到实体牌、网页和活动物料；不抹除必要审计
agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_en: Withdrawal reaches signs, web, and event material without erasing required audit

agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_zh: 争议样本与可定位派生版本禁用，不宣称模型可完全遗忘
agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_en: Disputed samples and traceable derivatives are disabled; no claim of perfect model forgetting

agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_zh: 不以原账号、原设备或家庭设备作为唯一身份路径
agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_en: The old account, device, or family device is never the only identity route

agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_zh: 待专业确认的必要留存与继续利用分开
agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_en: Potential lawful retention is separated from continued use pending professional review

agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_zh: AI不得从生日、学籍或外观自动宣布触发
agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_en: AI cannot declare the trigger from birth date, school status, or appearance

agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_zh: 纸表、人工联络与签收完成同一任务
agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_en: Paper forms, staffed contact, and signed receipts complete the same task

agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_zh: 删除合成演练数据、撤设施、公开去标识失败类型
agent_3_scenarios.human_floor_en: Delete synthetic rehearsal data, remove fixtures, and publish de-identified failure types

personas: 曾以监护代行参与、即将进入独立行权节点的青年
没有原设备或账号、需要纸面和人工路径的本人
共同创作者与需要拆分署名/内容关系的同伴
照护者或监护关系人，但不自动拥有持续控制权
青少年数据、隐私、版权与公共服务专业复核者
学校、社区、供应商退出时承担交接和下游同步的运营责任人

agent_4_landmarks.purpose_zh: 显示已知复制链、缺口与冻结状态，不显示个人身份
让本人选择继续、限期、导出、修订、撤回或挂起
用实体信号显示下游同步、争议与关闭，不播放个人内容

agent_5_culture.jingzhang: railway points and signed handovers make responsibility visible without stopping the public journey
agent_5_culture.zhongguancun: open questions, versioned provenance, reproducible tests, and public corrections
agent_5_culture.ai_new_culture: systems do not retain control merely because they retained data
agent_5_culture.message_zh: 到点交回本人；有争议先静默。
agent_5_culture.message_en: Return control when due; hold new use when disputed.

regional_synergy_boundary: All cross-area, annual, funding, partnership, and transformation items are concept invitations, not confirmed commitments.
